name_en: Silent product demo — the UI tells the story
what: الواجهة والمؤشر والكاميرا يحملون القصة، والكلمات تسمّي الخطوة أو النتيجة فقط. / Interface, cursor and camera carry the story; words only name a beat or an outcome.
how: Storyboard five columns: time · screen state · pointer action · camera focus · text. Frame 1 must already be legible. The camera moves toward the current action, then settles before the next one; one subject per beat; clear old props before the next beat. Animate from time only (deterministic). Before the full export render stills at: frame 0, each action, every transition midpoint, last frame — and watch it once muted.
params: stills: first · per action · transition midpoints · last

name_en: Intent → action → response with real latency
what: المؤشر يصل، يضغط، ثم تستجيب الواجهة بعد زمن استجابة واقعي. / The pointer arrives, presses, and the UI answers after a believable latency.
how: Response starts 60–120 ms after the press frame. 0 ms reads as a slideshow, more than 200 ms reads as a bug. Never animate success before the action completes. Direct-manipulation feedback lands within 100 ms; UI animations stay under 500 ms and look interruptible.
params: latency 60–120 ms; >200 ms = bug; feedback <100 ms; anim <500 ms

what: أسماء ومبالغ وتواريخ معقولة بلغة المشاهد؛ لا lorem ولا مؤشرات متناقضة ولا ميزة مخترعة. / Plausible locale-correct names, amounts and dates; no lorem, no contradictory KPIs, no invented features.
how: Write the strings first (Arabic UI labels ≥ 28 px at 1080 wide, line-height 1.6–1.8, letter-spacing 0). Use disposable test data when capturing a real app. Prices, countdowns and claims must be confirmed by the user — a fake price or countdown is forbidden. Saudi/Gulf money: SAR with tabular digits from one numeral system.

what: الشاشة تُبنى طبقات: خلفية ← إطار ← محتوى ← أدوات ← طبقات عائمة ← مؤشر ← شروح، ولكل طبقة جدولها الزمني. / Build the screen as background → chrome → content → controls → overlays → pointer → callouts, each with its own timeline.
how: Rebuild the UI as live DOM/SVG/Canvas with real strings at 2× density; keep a flattened screenshot only as the reference to match. If zoom makes a screenshot unreadable, re-capture at higher resolution or rebuild it as DOM. Depth comes from elevation tiers and overlap, plus 2–4% chrome/content parallax — not from tilt or glass.

what: قبل التحريك: أعد بناء الواجهة كـ DOM، صوّرها بدقة 3–5×، واقطع كل زر وأيقونة وشريحة كقطعة شفافة ≥ 1600 بكسل. / Before animating, rebuild the UI as DOM, shoot it at 3–5× and cut every button, chip and icon into a transparent part ≥ 1600 px.
how: Playwright element screenshots with omitBackground:true for transparent parts (Playwright + Chromium are installed here). Split the official SVG mark into layers and re-stack them; a PIL difference check must stay ≤ 1/255. Watch aspect: rendering 1200×800 parts into a 224×160 slot stretches 7%.

what: اعكس التفاعل لا العتاد: الشريط الجانبي يمين، الزر الأساسي يسار، الأسهم مقلوبة، والتقدم يمتلئ من اليمين. / Mirror interaction, not hardware: sidebar right, primary action left, chevrons flipped, progress fills right-to-left.
how: Use dir=rtl on the UI container only (not <html> in renders) with logical CSS (margin-inline-start, inset-inline-end). The cursor starts bottom-right; forward navigation pushes the new screen in from the left; toasts enter top-left (top-end). Phones: back chevron on the right, toggles 'on' at the left, tab order RTL; the island, camera and hardware buttons are NOT mirrored; hero copy sits right of the device with positive yaw. Phone numbers and times get unicode-bidi:plaintext. Cut typed text at graphemes with Intl.Segmenter. Narrow tab rows: 44 px fade on the inline-start edge plus proximity scroll-snap.
params: Arabic compact rows +10% line height; tab fade 44 px

what: سؤال واحد يسيطر واللوحة كلها تتراجع خلفه. / One question dominates; everything else recedes.
how: One focal view + subordinate context; 5–7 KPIs max (4–6 for an executive summary); legends next to the evidence; no wall of equal tiles. Animate the headline tile first, then the rest. Operations scenes show live/stale states explicitly (status dot with halo, see UI-45).

what: كل لحظة واجهة = مُطلِق ← قاعدة ← تغذية راجعة ← حالة مستقرة. / Every UI moment is trigger → rule → feedback → settled state.
how: Storyboard each UI beat as trigger → visible change → settled state, and score it with an 8-row checklist (score = passed/8 × 10). Physical metaphors stay shortened: drawers slide from their side, modals rise like cards, momentum scroll settles on a spring. Standard ranges: 150 ms micro, 250–300 ms transitions, 400–500 ms larger moves; whole-UI motion ≤ 700 ms, ≤ 3 flashes per second.

what: مكوّن حقيقي واحد يؤدي فعلًا واحدًا ويعود لبدايته بلا قفزة. / One real component performs one action and loops without a jump.
how: Use the component's real size, colours, shadows and timing; fit whole periodic cycles into the duration; one-shot actions return via a plausible reverse. Locked camera or one subtle push. Compare the first and last frames and watch several repeats for jumps or double triggers.
params: 3–6 s; one action; first frame == last frame

what: التسمية تقول الفعل («اختر ملفًا»، «اضغط تسجيل») لا رقم الخطوة. / Captions name the action ('CHOOSE A FILE', 'PRESS RECORD'), not decorative step numbers.
how: Open with the payoff, then explain steps over the action. One short line per decision; the pointer reaches the exact target and holds through the press; keep menus and overlays where the app places them.

what: سهم مرسوم يمر بمحطات زمنية على منحنى Hermite ويتوقف بسرعة صفر، ويضغط مع انضغاط الهدف. / A drawn arrow travels timed stops on a Hermite curve (zero velocity at holds) and presses with the target dipping.
how: c = M.cursor(stage,{size:30}); M.moveCursor(tl, c, [{t,x,y},…], {hold:[t…]}) samples the path at 60 fps into keyframes; M.press(tl, c, at, {target, down:.97}); M.typeOn(tl, el, text, at, {cps:46, hold:.6}). Rendered here: kit_v3_demo through render_html.cjs (6 s, 180 frames, VERIFY OK) after adding one bridge line, because the kit exposes window.__kosifSeek, not window.__kosif. (code snippet in references/powers/ui-product-device.md)
params: size 28–34 px (h ×1.22), drop-shadow 0 6px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28); travel 36–48 f, arc 15–25% of the path; press 0.88 over 4 f, recover 8 f; target 0.97

name_ar: واجهة منتج على Canvas بدالة draw(t)
what: شاشة تصعد، بطاقات تتتابع كل 50 ms، مؤشر يقطع 560 ms بقوس، وزر ينضغط 80 ms ويتحرر 140 ms — كله دالة نقية للزمن. / Screen rises, cards stagger 50 ms apart, a cursor arcs in 560 ms, the button presses 80 ms and releases 140 ms — all a pure function of time.
how: Copy the playbook block into starters/html-canvas and render: node tools/render_html.cjs --in index.html --out film.mp4 --width 1080 --height 1920 --fps 30 --mode seek. Rendered here: 120 frames, VERIFY OK. Lesson from the frames: the 23 px arrow is tiny at 1080 wide — scale the cursor ×1.5–2 for phone-sized output.
params: bg #0b0d12, panel #161a23, cards #1f2430, button #19c37d; push 1.00→1.05 over 4 s; screen rise 48 px in 0.52 s expoOut

what: يظهر عند القرار، يسير بسرعة شبه ثابتة على منحنى ناعم، يستقر على الهدف 200–400 ms ثم يضغط. / Appears only for decisions, glides at near-constant speed on a smooth curve, dwells 200–400 ms on target, then presses.
how: Plan waypoints per beat; interpolate with Catmull-Rom + arc-length so speed is constant; the tip (not the arrow's centre) lands on the hit target; hold through the pressed state; the UI response is visible before the cursor moves on. First appearance glides in from a short offset (−140, +90 px). Check tip-on-target in stills. Arrow for desktop scenes, translucent tap circle on phones — never an arrow on a phone.
params: glide ~450 ms per hop (380–700 ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)); dwell 200–400 ms; arrow 22–26 px with 1.5 px outline; tap circle 40–48 px at 25–35% opacity

what: عند النقرة تنكمش الحلقة من المؤشر وتتلاشى، أو تنطلق موجتان صغيرتان. / On click a ring scales out from the tip and fades, or two small ripples release.
how: Inject a fixed-position div so the ring is captured in frames; element.animate keyframes scale 0.45→1.25, opacity 1→0, 420 ms ease-out. The ripple element exists in the DOM from t=0 at opacity 0 (no creation mid-render). Product-UI style: ripple 0→48 px in 320–400 ms; phone tap ripple 0→64 px, opacity 0.6→0 over 300 ms.
params: ring 0.45→1.25 / 420 ms; ripple 48 px desktop, 64 px phone

name_ar: مؤشر ماك معبّر يتجه مع حركته
what: سهم أسود بحد أبيض يدور نحو اتجاه السرعة، يكبر عند المرور وينكمش عند الضغط، والكاميرا تقترب من النقرة. / Black arrow with white outline that rotates toward its velocity, grows on hover, shrinks on press while the camera zooms toward the click.
how: Rotation lerps toward atan2(vy, vx); decelerating glide; hover scale 1.55; press −15% for 3 frames; 32×39 px arrow with soft shadow. The 'oversized cursor' variant draws a 3.5× macOS arrow that lands, clicks and settles below the control.

name_ar: مؤشر بهالة لونية يلاحق هدفًا متحركًا
name_en: Cursor with accent halo homing on a live target
what: المؤشر يعيد حساب موضع الهدف كل إطار والكاميرا تنجرف، مع دائرة شفافة خلفه تنبض عند النقر. / The arrow re-reads the live element position every frame while the camera drifts; a translucent accent halo pulses on click.
how: Every frame read the target's transformed rect and steer toward it (no stale coordinates). Halo #f0442c at 40% alpha, 36 px; on click it shrinks and pulses 150 ms while the target shows its pressed state.

what: نقطة ناعمة تنجذب إلى الأزرار وتتحول إلى لوحة التمرير، والأيقونات تميل نحوها. / A soft dot is pulled into buttons, morphing into their hover plate while icons lean toward it.
how: HyperFrames component magnetic-cursor (vars visits '0,3', press 2, accent #3b82f6, tone light|dark). Hand-built rule: element offset = (cursor − centre) × factor, tween 0.3 s power2.out; leave → elastic.out(1,0.5) 0.5 s. Drive it from the scripted cursor path, never from a real mouse.
params: buttons factor 0.3, cards 0.1; return 0.5 s elastic.out(1,0.5)

what: المؤشر يمسك بطاقة، يرفعها ويميلها، يحملها لعمود فارغ، يفلتها فتستقر وتغلق القائمة الفجوة. / The cursor grabs a card, lifts and tilts it, carries it to an empty column and drops it while the list closes the gap.
how: Grab = press dip + lift; the ghost travels on tweens matched to the cursor (same position, duration, ease; immediateRender:false); drop = snap with selection chrome. Variants: fill-handle and corner-resize. HyperFrames component cursor-drag-drop (card_label, accent #0a84ff, tone light|dark).

name_en: Text select, marquee select & context menu
what: السهم يصير I-beam ويحدد نصًا ثم يضغط Bold؛ أو يسحب مستطيل تحديد على شبكة صور؛ أو يفتح قائمة نقر أيمن. / The arrow becomes an I-beam and selects text then clicks Bold; or drags a marquee over a photo grid; or blooms a right-click menu.
how: HyperFrames components: cursor-text-select (title, text, phrase, accent), cursor-marquee-select (start/end x,y in %, each touched tile rings and checks while a pill counts), cursor-context-menu (items list, pick index, the menu blooms from the cursor tip). For Arabic text select by whole words, never split letters.

how: Partition the canvas into zones so paths never cross; actions on alternating beats (~1.2 / 2.6 / 4.0 s); legs power2.inOut; press scale 0.88 for 0.07 s yoyo; one payoff at a time. Name tags are pills (radius 999) in each user's colour. Components: multiplayer-cursors (cursorCount 2–6, labels).

how: Component agent-cursor: agent_name, steps 'Reading the page,Opening Settings,…', targets 'x,y;x,y' in %, accent #0a84ff; extra duration becomes hold, never time-stretch. Render with npx hyperframes render — tested here: rendering its demo.html with render_html --mode virtual gives a frozen frame, because the paused window.__timelines and data-composition-src need the HyperFrames runtime.

what: دائرة تلامس شفافة تلمس الزجاج على إطار الاستجابة، نقرًا أو سحبًا. / A translucent contact circle touches the glass on the response frame, as tap or swipe.
how: Cue 60 ms before the press; press 90 ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1) with device 0.96 and button 0.92; release spring {stiffness 240, damping 14}; ripple 0→64 px, 0.6→0 opacity over 300 ms. Components: touch-indicator (gesture tap|swipe, polarity), gesture-tap (Follow → Following), swipe-rail (momentum carry, snap), pull-to-refresh (rubber band, pullDistance 120).
params: circle 40–48 px; press 90 ms; ripple 64 px / 300 ms

what: ثلاثة أزرار مفاتيح تنضغط بالتتابع، والأخير يمتلئ بلون التمييز ويطلق الحركة التالية. / Three rounded keycaps press in sequence; the last fills with the accent and triggers the next animation.
how: Each key: translateY 3 px + shadow shrink for 120 ms, 80 ms gap; last key fill accent then cut. Pair with a command palette (UI-30).

what: منزلق أو حقل يتغير والسطح المرتبط به يتغير في النبضة نفسها. / A scrubbed or typed control and its bound target change in the same beat.
how: Readout tween and target transform share one label, duration and ease (tl.addLabel('edit1'), shared SCRUB_DUR/SCRUB_EASE). While dragging, the control value is derived from cursor x; on release it springs to rest. Seen variants: settings sliders that move when the narration names them (knob 500 ms ease-in-out, inactive label 40% grey) and an accent swatch ring hopping every 350 ms while the whole UI recolours.

what: حروف تظهر بإيقاع شبه بشري مع مؤشر كتابة يومض، ومُحددة بالبذرة لا بالعشوائية. / Characters appear on a near-human rhythm with a blinking caret, seeded rather than random.
how: reveal = text.slice(0, floor(t·cps)) with a 1-frame hold every 2–3 chars from a seeded pattern (no Math.random in renders). Caret blink 500–530 ms (2 Hz), always visible while typing. Speeds: prompts 35–50 ms/char, terminals 35–45, human forms 70 ms ±20, search ~12 cps. Arabic: cut at grapheme clusters with Intl.Segmenter. motion-kit typeOn (cps 46) is rendered and proven in UI-11. (code snippet in references/powers/ui-product-device.md)
params: 35–50 ms/char prompts; 70 ±20 ms forms; caret 500–530 ms

name_ar: طلب يُكتب ثم يُرسل ثم يولّد
what: طلب يُكتب في حقل حقيقي، المؤشر يضغط إرسال، ثم تجيب الآلة: حالة تحميل ← إجابة متدفقة أو ناتج. / A prompt types into a real input, the cursor presses send, and the machine answers: status theater → streaming answer or artifact.
how: Blueprint prompt-type-submit-generate (5.2–12 s). Type ~35–50 ms/char with caret, send = button scale 0.9 + accent ring pulse 300 ms, then a thin progress bar fills ~1 s while a tile grid resolves tile by tile, or the result fades/scales in full-frame. Seen: centred 600×48 px pill on a dark frame; gradient-rim glowing search pill (1.5 px conic pink→violet→blue border + blurred copy below, blur 24 px at 0.35).
params: blueprint 5.2–12 s; ring 300 ms; progress ~1 s

what: رسالة المستخدم ← خطة الوكيل ← صفوف أدوات تدور ثم تتحول لعلامة صح بالتتابع ← بطاقة جاهزة. / User bubble → agent plan → tool-call rows spin then turn into checks in sequence → 'Ready' card.
how: Rows (mono 11–13 px, 'namespace · function') appear 250–600 ms apart; each spinner becomes a green check #2bb673 with a 0.6→1 scale pop; footer counters tick; optional terminal pane types output alongside. Status words can swap first (Queued → Reading → Drafting → Done) with HyperFrames state-chip-rail. Blueprint agent-progress-theater (4.2–11.6 s).
params: ticks 250–600 ms apart; check pop 250 ms

what: مشهد مراسلة كامل: شريط حالة، اسم جهة الاتصال، فقاعات بذيل، علامة استلام، رموز، بطاقة رابط ونقاط كتابة. / A full messaging scene: status bar, contact pill, tailed bubbles, receipt, emoji, link card and typing dots.
how: Components chat-thread (messages 'recv:…|sent:…|card:title~domain|emoji:…', beat 1.7 s), chat-message (entry scale 0.75 in 0.12 s from the sender corner), typing-indicator (three dots, vanish when the message lands). Hand-built: bubbles slide y+12 and fade, alternate sides, stagger 500 ms; Q&A answer bubble 300 ms back.out. Arabic: received bubbles on the left, sent on the right in RTL apps — mirror the tail.

how: 24 ready ~11–12 s blocks: VS Code (12 themes: dark-plus, light-plus, dark-modern, monokai, solarized-light…) with per-char typing and a pytest terminal, or macOS Terminal.app (12 profiles). Edit codeLines. Hand-built: 35–45 ms/char, block cursor in the accent colour, blink 500 ms. Diff rows: old line struck through grey (strike draw 250 ms), new line types in orange, rows 1.2 s apart.

what: حقل بحث يُكتب فيه، صفوف النتائج تنزلق، الصف الأول مميز، وEnter يتحول لإشعار. / Characters type into a search field, result rows slide in, the first row highlights and Enter collapses into a toast.
how: ~70 ms per char (or one char per beat subdivision on music); rows fade/slide 12 px in 250 ms; non-matching rows fade to 30% and collapse in 400 ms; matches move up with a yellow keyword highlight and a '1 result' label.

what: الإجابة تظهر سطرًا سطرًا، أو سجل أحادي الخط تُضاف إليه سطور بوسوم ملونة. / The answer appears line by line, or a mono log appends rows with coloured verb tags.
how: Bullet lines every ~120 ms after the question bubble. Live log: dark card radius 16 px, green live dot, mono endpoint rows with ✓ and '200' appended every ~120 ms; verb tags OBSERVE/CLICK/SCROLL. Skeleton reply: 3 grey bars (30 px high, 40–70% wide) grow to imply loading.

what: عنوان عريض ثم سطور تُكتب بإيقاع ضربات مقاس، والصفحة تتمرر لكل سطر ثم قطع إلى بطاقة ورقية. / A bold title then body lines typed on a measured keystroke rhythm, the page scrolling per line, then a cut to a paper card.
how: Component notes-typing (lines 'a|b|c', speed 0.5–2) and the 24.85 s 1080×1920 block notes-reveal (Courier Prime + Permanent Marker). Arabic version: swap the fonts for Arabic faces and type by grapheme.

what: أزمنة دقيقة لكل لحظة: ضغط، مرور، تبديل، فتح، إشعار، درج، هيكل، علامة صح، اهتزاز خطأ. / Exact timings for press, hover, toggle, expand, toast, drawer, skeleton, success check, error shake.
how: CSS transitions or WAAPI; the error shake is keyframes on x. Animate only transform and opacity (plus colour), never width/height in renders.
params: press scale 0.97–0.98 in 50–100 ms; hover 1.02; toggle 150–250 ms; expand 200–300 ms; fade 150–300 ms; drawer in 300 / out 250; modal 250 ms .95→1 (out 200); skeleton→content 200–400 ms; check draw 300–500 ms; shake x [0,−10,10,−10,10,0] 0.4 s; arrival bounce spring 200–400 ms

what: الأزرار تنخفض وتنكمش قليلًا عند الضغط وترتفع عند المرور، والأيقونات تدفع باتجاه القراءة. / Buttons press down and shrink, lift on hover, and inline icons nudge in the reading direction.
how: active: translateY(1px) scale(.985), svg scale(.92); hover (only under @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)): translateY(−1px); inline-end icon translateX(−3px), inline-start 2px; icon action rotate(−7deg) scale(1.06); metric cards lift −2px with icon rotate(−4deg). Transition only colour, background, border, shadow, transform, opacity at 150 ms ease-out. Touch targets ≥ 44 px.

what: انضغاط خطي ثم ارتداد نابض على الخاصية نفسها، مع انكماش الظل ودفقة وتوهج خلفي. / Linear compression then spring recovery on the same property, with shadow shrink, release burst and background glow.
how: Press linear scale 1 → PRESS_SCALE (~0.9) power1.in while the cursor compresses with it; release back.out(BOUNCE). Product-UI tokens: press 80 ms, release 140 ms spring k300 d20; the showreel pill flattens into a progress bar (scaleX 2.0 / scaleY .24 in .34 s) that fills linearly 1.1 s while a counter climbs.

what: مفتاح كبير يقلب مع تجاوز الإبهام وتلاشي لون المسار؛ أو تبديل الثيم يصبح حدثًا بصريًا. / An oversized toggle flips with thumb overshoot and a track-colour crossfade; or a theme switch becomes the event.

what: من مجلد أو رابط إلى خطة ثم بناء ثم تسليم لفيلم إطلاق موقع أو تطبيق. / From a folder or URL to plan → build → deliver for a site/app launch film.

what: «المستخدم يفعل كذا، والمنتج يفعل كذا بوضوح» — التقط التطبيق الحقيقي لا موك أب. / 'The user does X; the product visibly does Y' — capture the real app, not a mockup.
how: Leave a little time before/after the action; cut waits only where it does not misrepresent the experience; one visual focus at a time; words only when the picture can't say it. Capture with Playwright recordVideo, edit/reframe with ffmpeg, overlays with render_html.cjs. Deliver 16:9, 4:5, 9:16 and 1:1.

name_en: Browser recording CLI with cursor & contact sheet
what: سجّل التبويب النشط إلى webm/mp4 بـ 1–60 إطارًا مع مؤشر متحرك ولوحة لقطات تلقائية. / Record the active tab to webm/mp4 at 1–60 fps with an animated pointer and an automatic contact sheet.
how: agent-browser record start demo.webm --cursor --contact-sheet --fps 60 (needs the agent-browser install + ffmpeg). Default 30 fps; 60 for motion studies; 1–15 for long timelines. In this container prefer your own Playwright script (UI-72); desktop recorders (wf-recorder on Wayland, OBS, x11grab) are not usable headless here.

what: صف الشرائح وخطوات الشاشة والتعليق في YAML ثم يُرندر مع صوت وترجمة. / Describe slides, screencast steps and narration in YAML, then render with TTS narration and subtitles.
how: docker compose run video-guide-creator validate|generate guides/<slug>.yml (Edge TTS voices; edge-tts looks blocked from this container). Rule worth keeping: narration describes the action before it happens; brand presets hold colours, voice and logo.

what: شبكة 8 بكسل، زوايا 8/16/24، خط عنوان + مقاسان، وأربعة مستويات ظل. / 8 px grid, radii 8/16/24, one headline + two UI sizes, four elevation tiers.
how: Write them into STYLE.md first. Spacing 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64; type 12–36 on a ~1.2 scale (hero 36 px lh 1.1, body 16 px lh 1.75); measure 45–75ch. Shadows: sm 0 1px 2px .05 · md 0 4px 6px .1 · lg 0 10px 15px .1 · xl 0 20px 25px .15; product tiers 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12) → 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.35).

what: لوحة ضبابية بطبقات فوق خلفيات داكنة: ضبابية خلفية، تعبئة 5%، حد متدرج 1 بكسل، وظل محيطي كبير. / Layered frosted panels on dark scenes: backdrop blur, 5% fill, 1 px gradient border, large soft ambient shadow.
how: backdrop-filter blur(22–28px) saturate(150%) (40 px for modals); fill rgba(255,255,255,.05–.08); 1 px border gradient .12→.02 plus a 1 px inner highlight; box-shadow 0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25). Dark backgrounds only, max 3 cards, cards rise y 40→0 and unblur 12→0 with 80 ms stagger. Proven here: four glass cards on three parallax depths in the glass-luxury-logo film (13/13 checks). Needs Chromium's backdrop-filter. HyperFrames liquid-glass blocks need WebGPU/HTML-in-Canvas — unverified here.

what: مجموعة رموز واحدة تُعاد كسوتها بـ 14 شكلًا ووضعين وعلامات، مع استوديو للخط واللون والزوايا والتباين. / One token set re-skinned by 14 looks, light/dark and brand variants, plus a studio for font, accent, radius, scale and contrast.

KPI tile: white on mist, soft shadow, 4 px tone edge on the reading side, radius 18 px.

name_en: Product promo style (neon prompt + glass orb)
what: تايبوغرافي حركي لإطلاق منتج مع صندوق طلب نيون وكرة زجاجية وتقلب فاتح/داكن. / Launch-promo kinetic type with a neon prompt box, a glass orb and light/dark flips.
how: 16:9, 2.2 words/s, Readex Pro; bg #05050A, light #F8F7FF, ink #F5F3FF, grey #8B88A6, violet #A88BFF/#6C3BFF, blue #2F5BFF, pink #D946EF, orange #FF6A1A. Modes cycle big → prompt → orb → capsule → end; typing + click SFX on prompt lines, impact on the end card. Typewriter with a 3 px purple caret at ~18 chars/s while the parent scales 2.5→1 from the first character (camera pull-back synced to typing).

name_en: Sticker UI with hard offset shadow
what: بطاقات وأزرار بحد داكن سميك وزوايا كبيرة وظل صلب مزاح بلا ضبابية. / Cards, pills and buttons with a thick dark outline, big radii and a solid offset shadow with no blur.

what: وصفات متعددة المراحل لمشاهد الواجهة الشائعة، تُختار حسب الدور وتُذكر في الستوري بورد. / Multi-phase recipes for common UI scenes, picked by role and cited per beat in the storyboard.
how: Pick from blueprints-index.md by role: cursor-ui-demo (4.0–12.9 s), device-surface-showcase (5–11.3 s), prompt-type-submit-generate (5.2–12 s), agent-progress-theater (4.2–11.6 s), panel-edit-live-sync (5.3–11.9 s), transcript-scroll-artifact-reveal (5–11.8 s), zoom-out-workspace-reveal, cta-morph-press. 13 runnable 1920×1080 examples (hook-counter-burst 3.5 s … demo-page-scroll-spotlight 9 s) are the ground truth.

what: ثلاثة أساليب جاهزة للبناء: عرض SaaS، تفاعلات دقيقة، وواجهة زجاجية — مع كتيبي product-ui وphone. / Three ready styles — SaaS demo, UI micro-interactions, glass UI — backed by the product-ui and phone playbooks.
how: python3 tools/kosif.py scaffold saas-demo <dir> (or ui-micro, glass-ui); python3 tools/kosif.py list --category product-ui (82 entries) / --category phone (8). saas-demo: cursor 380–700 ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), press 80/140 ms, 8 px grid. ui-micro: hover 120–160 ms, press 0.96, ripple 0→48 px in 320–400 ms, focus zoom ≤ 1.4× with a 2× render.

what: الفيلم يُسلَّم صفحة ويب offline بتشغيل/إيقاف وإعادة ومنزلق 0.01 ث ورابط تحميل MP4 واحترام الحركة المخفضة. / The film ships as an offline web page with play/pause, restart, a 0.01 s range slider, an MP4 download link and prefers-reduced-motion support.
how: build.cjs templates an Arabic RTL page; rAF advances by min(dt, 0.1 s) and auto-stops at the end; window.render(t) clamps; window.setPlaying(bool); ?capture hides the chrome for rendering. Ran here: node player-test.cjs → PASS (initialisation, reduced motion, seek, deterministic frame, play/pause, restart, automatic stop, bounds).

name_en: Frame review: drag, resize & Arabic-safe shortcuts
what: في وضع التحرير يُسحب العنصر ويُحجّم من زاويته وتُحفظ القيم كنسب من الإطار، والاختصارات تعمل بلوحة مفاتيح عربية. / In edit mode elements drag and corner-resize with values saved as % of frame; shortcuts work on an Arabic keyboard layout.
how: Edits stored as '<id>.@box' = [x,y,w,h] in % (one decimal), 14 px corner grab radius, uniform scale ≥ 0.1. Keys bound to ev.code (KeyE, KeyN, BracketLeft/Right) so they survive the Arabic layout: Space play, ←/→ one frame, Shift+←/→ one second, [ ] scene, E edit, N note; speeds ½×/1×/2×; studio app keeps 60-step undo/redo.
params: box in % of frame; undo depth 60

name_en: Web deliverable rules (landing, perf, hover gating)
what: عندما يكون الناتج صفحة: أنماط هبوط، ميزانية أداء، والمرور فقط على مؤشر دقيق. / When the deliverable is a page: landing patterns, a performance budget, and hover only on fine pointers.
how: Hero (≤ 10-word outcome headline, one CTA, product in use) → social proof → 3–6 benefits → 3 steps → offer → FAQ → final CTA; container max 72rem; H1 clamp(28px,5vw,44px); breakpoints 360/768/1024/1280; 375 px without sideways scroll. Budget: LCP ≤ 2.5 s, CLS ≤ 0.1, INP ≤ 200 ms, JS ≤ 170 KB gz. @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) for hover lifts; touch targets ≥ 44 px; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

what: في أفلام الواجهات المؤشر هو البطل: كبير، ينقر برأس السهم، لا يغطي ما ينقره، ويتغير الزر بعد النقرة بإطارين. — In UI films the cursor is the hero: large, clicks with the arrow tip, never covers what it clicks, and the button changes two frames after the click.
when: عرض منتج أو تعليمي لواجهة — a product or tutorial demo of an interface.
how: Size 128–176 px at 1920 wide; hover 150–250 ms; press 1 → 0.96 → 1; state change 2 frames after the click; drag = lift + arc + target highlight + shrink into the slot; touch indicator 56–72 px. Headless browser recordings do not draw the pointer (seen here, QA-X02), so draw the cursor as its own layer.
params: 128–176 px; hover 150–250 ms; press 0.96; +2 frames to state change
license: owner (no LICENSE file)

what: انتقل من شاشة جهاز إلى الواجهة المسطحة بقلب القطبية (فاتح ↔ داكن)، وافصل طبقات الواجهة في العمق بمسافات متزايدة. — Move from a device screen to the flat UI with a polarity flip (light ↔ dark), and explode UI layers in depth with growing gaps.
when: كشف بنية تطبيق أو الانتقال من الهاتف إلى الشاشة الكاملة — revealing an app's structure or going from phone to full screen.
how: Exploded layers at z = k·(70 + 150·i); stagger in-plane movement only, 0.03 s per layer; keep text layers frontal (counter-transform) so they stay readable.
params: z = k·(70 + 150 i); 0.03 s per layer
license: owner (no LICENSE file)

what: سجّل تطبيق ويب حقيقي وهو يُستخدم إلى فيديو WebM عبر Playwright، ثم حوّله إلى MP4. — Record a real web app being used to a WebM video with Playwright, then convert to MP4.
when: عرض سريع لواجهة حقيقية حين لا يلزم إطار دقيق بالزمن — a quick demo of a real interface when frame-exact timing is not needed.
how: newContext({recordVideo: {dir, size: {width: 1280, height: 720}}}); drive the page (mouse.move with steps, down/up, typing); close the context to flush the file; `ffmpeg -i demo.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 demo.mp4`. Ran here (V9) with the preinstalled Node Playwright and its bundled Chromium: VP8 1280×720, 25 fps, 2.2 s. Limits: real-time capture (not seek(t), so not deterministic) and no pointer drawn — draw a cursor layer (UI-X01) or use the seek(t) capture pipeline for films.
params: 1280×720 VP8 25 fps; convert to H.264 30 fps
install: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium

name_en: Motion tokens and interface polish (React UIs)
what: لواجهات React: مدد من رموز ثابتة، ونوابض من خمسة إعدادات مسبقة، وتحريك transform وopacity فقط، واحترام تقليل الحركة؛ مع تفاصيل صقل تظهر في الفيديو. — For React UIs: durations from fixed tokens, springs from five presets, animate only transform and opacity, respect reduced motion; plus polish details that show on video.
when: بناء واجهة تفاعلية أو صفحة هبوط ستُصوَّر — building an interactive UI or landing page that will be filmed.
how: Import from motion/react; durations from a motionTokens object (instant / fast / normal / slow / crawl); springs from five presets (snappy, gentle, bouncy, instant, release); `initial` equals the server-rendered state; reduced motion → opacity only; never animate width/height/top/left/margin/padding. Polish: enter = opacity + small translateY (+ blur), exit shorter (~150 ms); press scale 0.96; icon swap = crossfade with scale and blur; never `transition: all`; tabular-nums for counters and timers; text-wrap: balance on headings; concentric radii (outer = inner + padding); hit areas ≥ 40–44 px.
params: exit ~150 ms; press 0.96; hit area ≥ 44 px
